title: Why Does Your Skin Glow After Sunlight?

scenes.text: Ever wondered why your skin looks luminous after a sunny walk?

scenes.label: UV‑INDUCED MELATONIN
scenes.text: UV light triggers a tiny rise in melatonin, a hormone that can give a subtle sheen.

scenes.label: OXYGENATED BLOOD VESSELS
scenes.text: Blood flow increases, bringing oxygen‑rich blood that reflects light more brightly.

scenes.label: SEBUM REFINEMENT
scenes.text: Heat softens sebum, creating a smooth surface that catches light like a natural highlighter.
